text_block_list.text:
Vodka defeated Daiwa Scarlet on the grand 
stage. Yet, she couldn't feel the same 
fiery passion from today's race as she 
once did.

Sensing that she couldn't keep competing 
like this, Vodka realized she needed to 
define and deepen the exact "coolness" she 
was aiming for.

The Trainer recommends the Victoria Mile 
to her, a mile race where she can go 
head-to-head in a battle of pure speed.

Until the day of the race, Vodka decided 
she would search for what she truly ought 
to strive for.
